_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Software Documentation
summary: The Software Documentation is used to support required reviews and Test Readiness Evaluations.
use_relationship:
The Software Documentation is used to support required reviews and Test Readiness Evaluations
This data item description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product resulting from the discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Software Documentation shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Software Documentation shall include activity and sequence diagrams, data dictionaries, and design products vaulted as drafts-in-process for the software design artifacts.

children.title: Procedures to assemble an installed computer program from the component software modules shall be included.
children.content: The documentation shall also include subprograms, commercial off the shelf and non-developmental items programs.

children.title: Unit test data sets and technical functional test scripts shall be included.
children.content: The equivalent data sets used to test the software unit shall be identified when unit test data sets are not used.

children.title: Quick reference cards, context sensitive help and simulations for the reusable learning objects shall be included.
